channel.title: LP News
channel.description: AI and tech news briefings, made for Luke with Muse.

item.title: Open Weights and Closed Gates
item.description: Moonshot's new open model (with a finance benchmark built on real fiscal documents), OpenAI's revealing week, the EU's AI data proposal, fresh iPhone exploits, Google's Android lockdown fight, and how much CO2 one AI request actually costs.

item.title: The Petty Cash Envelope
item.description: NVIDIA's free guardrail runtime for AI agents, the Signal chats that cost OpenAI researchers their jobs, PHP2Shell exploits caught before disclosure, eMudhra leaving the certificate business, Quad9 exiting France, and what 12 AI models all agree on about humans.

item.title: The Notary's Stamp
item.description: A certificate authority's private keys were exposed for months and what to do about it. Plus Anthropic's $80B "loss" (mostly an accounting charge), Mistral's new voice stack, why AI keeps citing fake statistics, and a Google Cloud power fault in London.

item.title: Space Bunny Confesses
item.description: The mystery "Space Bunny" model turns out to be MiniMax's new cheap model. Plus Mistral's tiny forecasting models, Amazon's cash-flow-negative AI bet, and a TV debloat tool.

item.title: One Key, One Purpose
item.description: OpenCode's breach and how to protect your API keys, OpenAI's newest rogue-AI incident reports, sites closing doors to AI agents, a Namecheap domain suspension, and Linux 7.2's AI-assisted commits.

item.title: Better, Faster, Same Price
item.description: DeepSeek ships a stronger model at the same price, Lean gets verified kernels, and Let's Encrypt shrinks certificates to 64 days. Plus Tencent's memory model and a tool for estimating local AI speed.

item.title: Just Timestamps
item.description: Anthropic's model solves the 25-year-old NIST ECDSA seed mystery, a critical GitLab emergency patch, FLUX 3 Klein open weights, Mercor's map of what AI benchmarks miss, and Google Play's private vibe-coded apps.

item.title: Tech Briefing October 15: Specs, Scion, Lawsuits, Apertus, TSMC, and AI Music Labels
item.description: Maya and Devon on October 15 news - Figma Specs, Anthropic Scion, eight-state OpenAI lawsuits, Apertus 1.5, TSMC earnings, and YouTube Music AI labels - with builder takeaways.

item.title: The Real AI Fears: What's Actually Scary Right Now
item.description: Maya and Ben separate fact from hype on AI risks — cybercrime at scale, deepfakes, job displacement numbers, and the fears worth having.

item.title: Welcome to LP's Podcast
item.description: A quick hello from the new home of the AI in Practice series, short fiction, and tech histories.

item.title: Claude's Big Week: Haiku 5.5, Cheaper Caching, and the Agent Swarm
item.description: Maya and Devon break down Anthropic's huge early-October 2026 release wave — Haiku 5.5, halved cache pricing, Claude Code mods — plus the planner-executor-reviewer playbook and what a working builder should do differently on Monday.
